summary: Runs the choice preview worker: a subject head per body drawn offscreen, recreated once after a crash, then off for the session.

faults.when: The worker crashed again after one recreation; previews are off for the session.

lifetime: Per window, while any row wants pictures; lingers briefly.

x-friction.gap: A live turn is a stream of frames produced by the worker while a drag steers it.
x-friction.closes: Work that yields a stream of results with one frame requested at a time.
